description: MT4/MetaApi Connector Architecture - Full client-side MT4 integration targeting MetaApi.cloud's REST+WebSocket contract using raw Retrofit+OkHttp (no MetaApi SDK). Includes domain models, API service, data source, WebSocket quote stream, repository, UI screens (login + account), ViewModel, DI module, DataProvider enum entry, wiring into MarketRepositoryImpl, and unit test.
steps: Create domain/model/Mt4Account.kt with data classes: Mt4Credentials(login: Int, password: String, server: String, platform: String = 'mt4'), Mt4AccountInfo(login, balance, equity, margin, freeMargin, leverage, currency, name, server), Mt4Position(ticket, symbol, type: Mt4OrderType, lots, openPrice, openTime, sl, tp, profit, swap, commission), Mt4OrderType enum (BUY, SELL, BUY_LIMIT, SELL_LIMIT, BUY_STOP, SELL_STOP)
Create domain/model/Mt4Quote.kt with data class Mt4Quote(symbol, bid, ask, timestamp, spread = ask - bid)

Create data/remote/api/MetaApiService.kt - Retrofit interface targeting MetaApi REST endpoints: POST /users/current/accounts (deploy), GET /users/current/accounts/{id}/account-information, GET /users/current/accounts/{id}/positions, POST /users/current/accounts/{id}/trade. Use placeholder base URL from BuildConfig (METAAPI_BASE_URL). Auth via Bearer token header from AppPreferences.metaApiToken.
Create data/remote/api/MetaApiDataSource.kt - wraps the Retrofit calls, maps DTOs to domain models, handles errors. Follow BinanceDataSource pattern exactly.

Create data/remote/websocket/Mt4QuoteStream.kt - models a live-quote WebSocket connection (OkHttp WebSocket to MetaApi streaming endpoint). Exposes Flow<Mt4Quote> for subscribed symbols. Start/stop lifecycle. Uses existing OkHttpClient from DI via @PublicMarketDataClient.

Create domain/repository/Mt4Repository.kt - interface: connect(credentials), disconnect(), getAccountInfo(), getPositions(), streamQuotes(symbols): Flow<Mt4Quote>, placeTrade(symbol, type, lots, sl?, tp?), closeTrade(ticket)
Create data/repository/Mt4RepositoryImpl.kt - implements Mt4Repository using MetaApiDataSource + Mt4QuoteStream. @Singleton @Inject constructor.
Create feature/mt4/presentation/Mt4UiState.kt with sealed states (Disconnected, Connecting, Connected) and data fields for account info and positions.
Create feature/mt4/presentation/Mt4ViewModel.kt - @HiltViewModel, standard MVVM pattern following AuthViewModel.
Create feature/mt4/presentation/Mt4LoginScreen.kt - Compose screen: login(Int), password, server fields + connect button + error state. Follow LoginScreen.kt pattern exactly.
Create feature/mt4/presentation/Mt4AccountScreen.kt - shows account info (balance/equity/margin) + open positions list.
Create di/Mt4Module.kt - Hilt module providing MetaApiService (via @MetaApiRetrofit qualifier) + Mt4Repository binding. Follow NetworkModule pattern for the Retrofit instance.
Add MT4 entry to DataProvider enum: MT4('MT4 (MetaApi)', supportsLive = true, requiresApiKey = true, apiKeyLabel = 'MetaApi Token', implemented = true)
Add metaApiToken field to AppPreferences (following the same pattern as apiKeys for other providers).

Create unit test: app/src/test/java/com/foxtrader/app/data/remote/api/MetaApiDataSourceTest.kt - fake the Retrofit interface, verify mapping of account info and positions DTOs to domain models. Follow BybitDataSourceTest pattern.
acceptance_criteria: Mt4Account.kt, Mt4Quote.kt domain models compile with correct fields and types
MetaApiService.kt is a valid Retrofit interface with correct HTTP method annotations and paths
MetaApiDataSource.kt maps DTOs to domain models correctly (verified by unit test)
Mt4QuoteStream.kt exposes Flow<Mt4Quote> and manages OkHttp WebSocket lifecycle
Mt4Repository interface and implementation follow existing repository patterns
Mt4LoginScreen follows LoginScreen.kt composition pattern (OutlinedTextField, Button, error state)
Mt4AccountScreen shows account info and positions in a scrollable layout
Mt4Module properly provides MetaApiService via a qualified Retrofit and binds Mt4Repository
DataProvider.MT4 entry exists with correct metadata
MetaApiDataSourceTest uses FakeMetaApiService (no MockK), asserts real computed values
verification: Source-level validation: verify all class signatures, imports, and DI annotations are consistent with the project patterns
Verify unit test follows the FakeXxxApi pattern from BybitDataSourceTest and asserts domain model mapping
